description: Get full Walmart product detail. No reviews (use get_walmart_reviews) or offers (use get_walmart_offers). seller_catalog_id is the NUMERIC id for seller endpoints. 1 credit. Optional store targeting: delivery_zip + store_id together (store_id from get_walmart_stores) - 2 credits, takes 10-60s, store echoed in data.location; 404 if that store does not carry the item. domain 'ca' only with a store pair.

delivery_zip.description: Shopper postal code: 5-digit US ZIP, or Canadian postal code (e.g. 'M5V 2T6') with domain 'ca'. Must be passed with store_id.

store_id.description: Walmart store id from get_walmart_stores (same domain). Must be passed with delivery_zip. The store used is echoed in data.location.

name: get_walmart_product
